title: Predication hyperdoctrine
description: JSON Schema for a predication hyperdoctrine — a predication fibration additionally carrying quantifier adjoints in both the knowledge and truth orders, Frobenius reciprocity, Beck–Chevalley coherence, and comprehension. The schema records the data: the underlying fibration and the eight adjoint/comprehension tables. Conditions B1k, B1t, B2k, B2t, B3, B4t, B4k are runtime properties checked by a verifier.

exists-k.description: Left adjoint to reindexing in the knowledge order. Map from morphism-id to a fiber-algebra-to-fiber-algebra functor table.

forall-k.description: Right adjoint to reindexing in the knowledge order.

exists-t.description: Left adjoint to reindexing in the truth order.

forall-t.description: Right adjoint to reindexing in the truth order.

comprehension-t.description: Optional comprehension adjoint for the truth-order system: extension functor C/p → E_p has right adjoint {p : -}_t : E_p → C/p.

comprehension-k.description: Optional comprehension adjoint for the knowledge-order system.
